mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REFRESH_TOKENS ( TOKEN_ID, USER_ID, TOKEN_VALUE, EXPIRES_AT, REVOKED_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_REFRESH_TOKENS.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{tokenValue}, #{expiresAt}, 'N', #{createdAt} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM REFRESH_TOKENS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TOKEN_VALUE = #{refreshToken} AND REVOKED_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE REFRESH_TOKENS SET REVOKED_YN = 'Y', REVOKED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TOKEN_VALUE = #{refreshToken}
